crossChapterNote: FSP Ch5 케플러 공유지 선언과 동시간대. FSP Ch4 Sandstone 약속의 결과.

text.en: The outer edge of Kepler Crater.
FSP was inside.
The day Liang Wei declared.

text.ko: CV는 밖에서 봤다. 이것이 CV의 위치였다.
text.en: CV watched from outside. That was CV's position.

text.ko: 안이 아닌 곳. 그것이 항상 CV의 위치였다.
text.en: Not inside. That had always been CV's position.
Kepler Crater. Western Mars.
Sixty kilometers across. Three kilometers deep.
Ancient metal veins at the bottom.
MCC claimed ownership. With documents. With law.
Miners claimed ownership. With their bodies. With thirty years.

text.ko: CV는 아무것도 주장하지 않았다. 그냥 지켰다.
text.en: CV claimed nothing. Just watched.
Butcher came. That was rare.
Butcher leaving the base.

text.ko: 왼팔 의수. 광산용 구식. 외투가 있었다.
text.en: Left arm prosthetic. Old mining type. He had a coat.
His hand was in the pocket.

text.ko: 그 주머니 안에 무엇이 있는지는 알고 있었다.
text.en: What was in that pocket was known.
A photo. Thirty years old.
Kepler belongs to nobody?

text.ko: 30년 전에도 그 말이 있었어. 광산이 누구 것도 아니라고.
text.en: Thirty years ago there were those words too. That the mines didn't belong to anyone.

text.ko: 광부들 것이라고. 그다음에 어떻게 됐는지는 알아.
text.en: That they belonged to the miners. You know what happened after that.

text.ko: 그래도 봐. Cinder가 말했어. 이번엔 다를 수 있다고.
text.en: Watch anyway. Cinder said this time might be different.
The thing thirty years ago.
Butcher had been seventeen. A mining accident.

text.ko: MCC가 보상을 거부했다. 그가 직접 팔을 만들었다.
text.en: MCC refused compensation. He built his own arm.
Even then miners had gathered. Declared.
MCC sealed it. People disappeared.

text.ko: Butcher는 사진을 가지고 있었다. 그 사람들의.
text.en: Butcher kept a photo. Of those people.
Lena from FSP side is visible.

text.ko: Sandstone에서 봤던 사람이에요. 빠른 사람. 팔에 이름들이 있는.
text.en: The person I saw at Sandstone. The fast one. With names on her arm.

text.ko: Zone 12 이름도 있었어요. 우리 것. Lena가 왜 그 이름을 가지고 있는지 물어봐야 해요.
text.en: Zone 12 name was there too. Ours. Need to ask why Lena has that name.
Later. Watch now.
A sound came from inside the crater.
Liang Wei's voice.

text.ko: 선언. 30년 동안 혼자 기다린 사람의 목소리.
text.en: The declaration. The voice of someone who had waited alone for thirty years.
The voice echoed off the crater walls.
Butcher listened.
The hand in the coat pocket didn't move.

text.ko: Liang Wei. 노인이에요. 80대. 30년 동안 케플러에 살았어요.
text.en: Liang Wei. An old man. Eighties. Lived at Kepler for thirty years.

text.ko: 혼자서요. 거기 있었어요. 아무도 주목 안 했어요.
text.en: Alone. He was just there. Nobody noticed.
We noticed. CV did.
We noticed. Didn't touch him.

text.ko: 케플러 분화구는 누구 것도 아니었어. 30년 전부터.
text.en: Kepler Crater wasn't anyone's. Since thirty years ago.

text.ko: 그래서 Liang Wei가 거기 있을 수 있었어.
text.en: That's why Liang Wei could be there.
Liang Wei's declaration was audible.

text.ko: '케플러는 공유지입니다. 화성에 사는 모든 사람의 것.'
text.en: 'Kepler is common land. It belongs to everyone living on Mars.'

text.ko: 말이 단순했다. 그것이 30년을 기다린 사람의 말이었다.
text.en: Simple words. That was what a person who had waited thirty years said.
What was simple was what was old.
MCC drone went up. One.
Two.
Three. Escalating.
I know. Watching.
Preparing to intervene. When the declaration ends.
Thirty years ago there were also drones. Different ones.
Butcher looked at the sky.

text.ko: 외투 주머니에서 손을 꺼냈다. 사진을 꺼내지 않았다. 손만.
text.en: He took his hand from the coat pocket. Not the photo. Just the hand.

text.ko: 그 손. 오른손. 의수가 아닌 손.
text.en: That hand. Right hand. The hand that wasn't prosthetic.

text.ko: 드론 세 개가 분화구 상공에 있었다.
text.en: Three drones were above the crater.
Liang Wei continued the declaration.

text.ko: FSP 사람들이 듣고 있었다. 그 안에서.
text.en: FSP people were listening. Inside.
Lena is at the inner rim of the crater.

text.ko: Zone 12 이름을 가지고 있는 사람이에요. 팔에.
text.en: The person who has the Zone 12 name. On her arm.
What is Zone 12.

text.ko: 내가 거기서 태어났어요. CV가 되기 전.
text.en: I was born there. Before I became CV.

text.ko: MCC가 봉쇄했어요. 사람들이 사라졌어요. 나는 나왔어요.
text.en: MCC sealed it. People disappeared. I got out.

text.ko: Lena의 팔에 그 이름이 있는 이유를 모르겠어요.
text.en: I don't know why Lena has that name on her arm.
Zone 12. A name existed.
MCC sealed zone. Unofficial residential area.
Cinder Grace had been born there.
Lena had that name on her arm.

text.ko: 두 사람이 같은 이름으로 연결되어 있었다.
text.en: Two people connected by the same name.
There were names.
Drones are descending.
Intervention ready. As expected.
Liang Wei is still declaring.
When the declaration ends MCC goes in.
Same as thirty years ago.
This time has to be different.
The declaration continued inside the crater.

text.ko: '이 땅은 우리가 가꾼 것입니다. 30년 동안. 이름으로. 손으로. 살아서.'
text.en: 'This land is what we have tended. For thirty years. By name. By hand. By living.'
Liang Wei's voice trembled. An eighty-year-old voice.
But it was a declaration.

text.ko: Butcher가 외투 주머니에 손을 다시 넣었다.
text.en: Butcher put his hand back in the coat pocket.
His hand touched the photo.
Four drones now. Added one.
MCC ground forces also at west of crater.
I know.
Decision needed. Butcher.
Wait until the declaration ends.
Then MCC goes in.

text.ko: 30년 전에 내가 그 선언을 지키지 못했어.
text.en: Thirty years ago I failed to protect that declaration.

text.ko: 그 사람들이 사진 안에 있는 이유야.
text.en: That's why those people are in the photo.

text.ko: 이번엔 선언이 끝나는 걸 들어야 해. 그다음에 결정해.
text.en: This time I need to hear the declaration finish. Then decide.
Understood.
... Understood.
The declaration continued.
Liang Wei called names.
The names of people who had died at Kepler over thirty years.
Called them one by one.
The crater walls echoed those names.
Butcher listened.
There are names.
I heard Zone 12 names too.
Yes.

text.ko: Liang Wei가 어떻게 알고 있어요. 그 이름들을.
text.en: How does Liang Wei know those names.

text.ko: 30년 동안 기다리면서 이름을 모았어. 그게 그 사람이 한 일이야.
text.en: He collected names while waiting thirty years. That was what he did.
MCC drones descended lower.
Ground forces moved from the crater's west.
The declaration would end soon.
Then MCC would go in.

text.ko: Liang Wei와 FSP 사람들이 그 안에 있었다.
text.en: Liang Wei and FSP people were inside.
Lena was at the inner rim.
Butcher took his hand from the coat pocket.
Took out the photo. First time.
Thirty years old. Paper. Worn with handling.
Cinder saw. Crow saw.
First time seeing that photo.

text.ko: 사람들이 있었다. 사진 안에. 젊은 사람들이었다.
text.en: People were in the photo. Young people.
Who are they.
The people who declared at Kepler thirty years ago.
The people who disappeared when MCC sealed it.
This time has to be different.

text.ko: 그래서 봐야 했어. 선언이 끝나는 걸.
text.en: That's why I had to watch. The declaration ending.
The declaration inside the crater ended.
'Kepler is common land. This is our declaration.'
Liang Wei's voice echoed. For the last time.
People applauded. Inside.
MCC drones moved toward the crater entrance.
Done. I heard it.
This time I'll protect it.
MCC drones four. Ground forces twenty.
I know.
It's the Sandstone Promise. With Lena. Execute now.

prompt.ko: MCC가 들어가려 한다. Butcher가 결정했다. 어떻게 실행합니까.
prompt.en: MCC is about to enter. Butcher has decided. How do you execute.

text.en: Take out the drones. All CV forces.

preview_hint.en: → War with MCC. Butcher leads from the front.

text.en: Contact Lena first. Joint defense.

preview_hint.ko: → Lena가 즉시 반응한다. Sandstone 약속 실행
preview_hint.en: → Lena responds immediately. Sandstone Promise executed.

text.en: Let Butcher stand at the front himself.

preview_hint.en: → Butcher puts the photo away. The weight of thirty years.

text.en: Wait. Decide after seeing MCC's reaction.

preview_hint.ko: → Cinder가 당신 옆에 선다. 함께 기다린다
preview_hint.en: → Cinder stands beside you. Waits together.

subtitle.en: Kepler Edge — The Value of the Sandstone Promise

text.ko: 30년 전에 못 한 걸 오늘 했어.
text.en: Today we did what couldn't be done thirty years ago.

text.ko: 그때도 누군가 선언했어. 그때는 아무도 지키지 않았어.
text.en: Someone made a declaration back then too. Back then nobody protected it.
This time we protected it.
Yes.
MCC drones withdrew.
Ground forces also withdrew.
Kepler Crater went quiet.
Liang Wei appeared at the crater entrance.

text.ko: 80대 노인. 작은 사람. 그러나 선 것이었다.
text.en: An old man in his eighties. Small person. But standing.

text.ko: Butcher를 봤다. Liang Wei가. 말이 없었다.
text.en: Liang Wei looked at Butcher. No words.
You're CV.
Yes.
Do you know the people who declared here thirty years ago?
I know them. I have a photo.

text.ko: 나는 이름들이 있어. 그 사람들. 30년 동안 모았어.
text.en: I have names. Those people. I collected them for thirty years.
Liang Wei took out paper.

text.ko: 접힌 것. 낡은 것. 손때가 탔다.
text.en: Folded. Old. Worn with handling.
He handed it to Butcher.
Butcher took it.
Didn't unfold it. Just held it.
That was enough.
Look at Lena.
Where is she.
Crater entrance. Over there.
CV protected it.
It's the Sandstone Promise. Remember?
... I remember. The Zone 12 name.
Cinder and Lena looked at each other.

text.ko: Zone 12 이름이 있었다. 두 사람 사이에.
text.en: The Zone 12 name was there. Between two people.
Cinder had been born there.

text.ko: Lena가 팔에 그 이름을 가지고 있었다.
text.en: Lena had the name on her arm.
The reason needed to be asked.

text.ko: 그러나 오늘은 아니었다. 오늘은 다른 날이었다.
text.en: But not today. Today was a different day.
What will you do with Kepler.
CV has no demands. Common land is common land.
That's all.
The Zone 12 name is for later.
... Understood.
Butcher put the paper in his pocket.
Together with the photo.

text.ko: 두 개의 종이가 같은 주머니에 있었다.
text.en: Two pieces of paper in the same pocket.
A thirty-year-old photo. Names received today.
Butcher looked at the crater.
For a long time.
MCC sealed the crater.
Butcher watched.
His hand went back in the coat pocket.

text.ko: 사진 위에 손이 놓였다. 30년 전과 같은 것이었다.
text.en: Rested on the photo. Same as thirty years ago.

text.ko: 달랐던 것은 Cinder가 옆에 있었다는 것이었다.
text.en: The difference was that Cinder was beside him.
And Liang Wei's names existed.
Kepler turned red.
Butcher took his hand from the coat pocket.
Not the photo. Just the hand.

text.ko: 그 손. 오른손. 의수가 아닌 손.
text.en: That hand. Right hand. The hand that wasn't prosthetic.

text.ko: 30년 전 사진 안 사람들이 아직 거기 있을 것이었다.
text.en: The people in the thirty-year-old photo would still be there.

text.ko: 사진 안에서만. 그러나 오늘 케플러 외곽에도 있었다.
text.en: Only in the photo. But today they were also here at the edge of Kepler.
Because of the declaration.
